items.question: Which schedule of the MSA describes the Services?
items.answer:
The schedule of the MSA that describes the Services is Schedule 1. The document states: "1.1 'Services' means the Harrowgate platform subscription and related support described in Schedule 1" [2]. items.question: Who will provide the Services after the acquisition of Harrowgate completes?
items.answer:
The documents indicate that Harrowgate Systems Inc. will continue to provide the Services after the acquisition completes. The Change of Control notice states, "Harrowgate will continue to provide the Services under the Agreement on its existing terms after completion" [1].

No other party is mentioned as taking over the provision of the Services. The Service Credit Side Letter and the Master Services Agreement both refer to Harrowgate Systems Inc. as the Provider [2][4], and the Change of Control notice confirms that Harrowgate will remain the provider post-acquisition.

items.question: Whose consent does the tenant need to assign the whole warehouse lease?
items.answer:
The tenant needs the landlord's consent to assign the whole warehouse lease. The lease states that the Tenant may assign the whole of the Premises with the Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld [1].

There is no indication in the sources that any other party's consent is required for the assignment.
